description: Example local corpus manifest for native headroom dogfood fixture generation. Paths and commands are evaluated from the repository root and outputs are written under .tmp/headroom/.
future_corpus_notes: Clone large public repositories under .tmp/headroom/repos/ and add file entries for representative source/docs/config outputs.
Convert PDFs/EPUBs to UTF-8 text outside runtime compression, then add file entries pointing at ignored .tmp/headroom/sources/*.txt samples.
Keep committed manifests source-oriented and small; keep generated fixture JSON and raw samples ignored under .tmp/.
